notes.subject: דהרות דהרות
notes.rationale: Infinitive-verb pair 'galloping, galloping' mimics hoofbeats; kept as 'ran ran'.

notes.subject: הלמו
notes.rationale: 'Struck/hammered' — whose hoofs: the stamping of fleeing horses or broken by beating; both ancient readings.

notes.subject: אביריו
notes.rationale: 'His mighty ones' — warriors or stallions; both attested.

translation: Long taim dispela, ol hap bilong ol hos i pait i go daun — ol i ran ran, ol strongpela man bilong en i ran olgeta.

tokens.gloss: ol strongpela man bilong en i ran olgeta
